authored_fail_closed.trigger: Bad formulation, thickness, age, damage or contamination
authored_fail_closed.response: Quarantine; request newly qualified specimen or service review. No automatic recure or cleanup recipe.

authored_fail_closed.trigger: Missing containment or hazardous-patterning service receipt
authored_fail_closed.response: Hold R07 and every dependent microscopy path; macro unpatterned route may remain independently designable.

authored_fail_closed.trigger: RH drift, focus loss, missing frames, wrong volume or stack blur
authored_fail_closed.response: Mark acquisition incomplete/failed; preserve evidence and only repeat on a separately qualified spot under a new droplet/acquisition ID.

authored_fail_closed.trigger: Ambiguous array matching, nonstationary edge or interpolated-point excess
authored_fail_closed.response: Hold reconstruction, retain partial measured coordinates; never synthesize an authoritative reference.
Report both source statements and quarantine dependent numerical results pending qualified reconciliation.

authored_fail_closed.trigger: Instrument/service fault or any route abort
authored_fail_closed.response: Safe-state service and custody closeout are reachable immediately from every route; they do not wait for scientific analysis success.

not_reported_or_implemented: Closed-loop humidity or stage fault reset
Tensile specimen reuse after large strain
